verdict.rationale: Termius's first-party docs say Vaults are end-to-end encrypted cloud storage for Hosts, Keys, Snippets, Port Forwarding rules and Known Hosts that sync across devices. Logging in on a new device syncs vaults, hosts and configurations automatically, and the app runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android. Data is also stored locally for offline connections. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cross-device sync, and documentation of offline-edit conflict handling.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sync my saved hosts and connection settings across all my devices

citations.quote: Vaults in Termius are the end-to-end encrypted cloud storage for Hosts, Keys, Snippets, Port Forwarding rules, and Known Hosts. Vaults enable sync across devices
Log in to your account — your Vaults, hosts, and configurations will be synced automatically.
Every account includes a Personal vault, accessible only to you and synced across all your devices.
Termius is available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android, so you can use it across all your devices.
Your infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally. Connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN.
